think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with a natural ordering. 3) If numeric, look for sentinel values (e.g., -1/0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) compared to ordinary numeric scaling. 4) Classify as 'special knob' only if such sentinel numeric values exist; otherwise not. 5) If special, record the sentinel value(s).
